type:
Roth.index_mul.{u_1} {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] {P Q : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ)
  {r : σ → ℕ} (hr : ∀ (j : σ), 0 < r j) : Roth.index (P * Q) α r = Roth.index P α r + Roth.index Q α r
what: The point index of the product of two nonzero real multivariate polynomials is the sum of the indices.
how: Clear positive reciprocal denominators to natural weights, translate and coerce into multivariate power series, invoke existing weightedOrder_mul, and project finite ENat values through toNat and real scaling.
hypotheses: σ/Fintype and ℝ are fixed parent-interface constraints. hP and hQ are necessary uniformly under real default-zero index; both zero-factor counterexamples compiled. hr is removable: D=∏ max 1 (r i) is positive and D/0=0 provides the natural weight for a zero reciprocal denominator.
caller_summary: Two source proof applications: Roth.index_prod at Index185 and private Roth.index_separated_mul_le_aux at Theta438. Exact293 kernel audit independently finds precisely these two consumers. Both entire callers compiled with the hr-free replacement.
mathlib_api_audit: Existing MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul verified in isolation at Semiring/NoZeroDivisors generality, arbitrary σ and natural weights. AddMonoidAlgebra.le_infDegree_mul is only an inequality; supDegree_mul additionally requires injective degree. Real-weight component/decomposition infrastructure exists but no analogous general real-weight equality was established.
moral_duplications: The natural-weight algebraic core is exactly the existing series multiplication theorem. The old real-index spelling requires genuine normalization and finite projection; new comparison proofs from133/143 are not preexisting mathlib calls.
generalization: Verified exact-interface deletion of hr. Expanded natural-series law removes Fintype, ℝ, Taylor center, positivity and factor nonvanishing via infinity at zero; compiled. Broader arbitrary-real polynomial infDegree multiplication is a design proposal, not a compiled weakening.
missing_api: Potential extremal weighted-homogeneous component multiplication and arbitrary-real polynomial infDegree multiplication law. Existing component, support, graded decomposition APIs support arbitrary additive commutative weight monoids. Scope/normal-form design remains open; no absence theorem claimed.
junk: Not junk: two callers, one in another module, and a module main result. No independent production inline duplicate found.

questions: For polynomial finite-support orders, should the primary upstream law be stated directly for AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree with real additive variable weights, rather than through natural MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder?
Should the broader law first expose an extremal weightedHomogeneousComponent multiplication API for arbitrary ordered additive weight targets, with the polynomial infDegree result as its corollary?

Should the reciprocal-weight real index remain project-local, using the independently checked natural-series normalization and existing weightedOrder_mul, while the broader infDegree/initial-form API is developed separately?
action.local_refactor: Use the proved hr-free replacement at both call sites; full replays preserve their statements. For Theta the formerly sole-used hr0 becomes unused and can be renamed _hr0 without changing its position/type. Keep real default-zero nonvanishing guards.
action.upstream_scope: Decide primary polynomial finite-order interface and whether to develop component multiplication as its reusable foundation. Do not submit a duplicate natural weightedOrder_mul.
